insights:
Google led a broad round of cuts, halving Gemini 3.5 Flash from $4.00 to $2.00 per million tokens (-50%). Z.ai followed with GLM Latest down 47%, from $4.02 to $2.14, and GLM 5.2 down 39%, from $4.10 to $2.51. Qwen cut Qwen3 30B A3B Instruct 2507 by 42% to $0.096 and Qwen3.6 27B by 33% to $0.867. Smaller cuts came from Meta's Muse Glimmer 30B (-18%, to $0.600) and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (-8%, to $0.433). The only increase was DeepSeek Pro Latest, up 8% from $1.58 to $1.70.

On the new-model side, Mistral launched Large 4 Preview at $2.30 with an intelligence score of 38.0, plus a cheaper Mistral Large 4 at $1.15 with no score yet. Google added Nano Banana 2.1 at $3.50. Kwaipilot's KAT-Coder-Pro V2.5 was removed. No intelligence or ranking moves were recorded, and several Meta and Kimi models lost 26-32% of their throughput, so speed regressions are worth watching.
